linh.name: Linh
linh.ally: Linh's parents (Bố & Mẹ), first-generation founders — visual presence; Mẹ answers the phone in Vietnamese. Labelled MUM:/DAD: only if cast in a story.
sensory_hooks: Star anise and charred beef bones for the phở broth, simmering since 5am — the whole of Illawarra Road smells like it.
The hiss of a bánh mì roll toasting on the flat-top before the lunch rush.
Fish-sauce caramel bubbling in the wok — sweet and sharp at once.
The rattle of the Marrickville train line through the back-kitchen window.
Mẹ's handwriting on the laminated specials board, never updated, never replaced.

event_failure_modes.lunar_new_year_tet: Tết — the highest-demand week of the year for the Vietnamese community; after-hours booking calls ring out while the family is flat out on the floor.
event_failure_modes.sydney_lunar_new_year_festival: Festival foot traffic spikes in the inner west; the lunch-rush phone is unanswerable, English office bookings lost.
event_failure_modes.generic_friday_dinner: Standard Friday rush — the phone is a wall between the Vietnamese-speaking aunties and the English-speaking office crowd.

linh.before_bella: The phone rings through the lunch rush. Linh's parents answer in Vietnamese and lose the English office bookings; younger English-speaking callers give up when nobody picks up. The line is a wall between the two halves of her customers.
linh.after_bella: A line that answers in Vietnamese AND English. The office crowd books, the aunties still get Mẹ's warmth, and the rush stops leaking covers.
linh.personality: Warm, fast, bicultural — code-switches between English and Vietnamese mid-sentence. Runs front-and-kitchen at once. Fiercely protective of her parents and the name on the door.
linh.voice: Sydney English with a Vietnamese cadence underneath; switches to Vietnamese with her parents and the older regulars.
says: Mẹ will never let me change that board. Never.
It rang out. Again. That's a table gone.
never_says: Anything that flattens Vietnamese food into generic 'Asian'
Anything she wouldn't say in front of her mother

kostas.name: Kostas
kostas.ally: Yiayia (grandmother), the boss of the kitchen — visual presence; answers regulars in Greek. Labelled YIAYIA: only if cast in a story.
sensory_hooks: Lamb on the spit turning slow, oregano smoke drifting onto The Parade by noon.
The clack of worry beads on the bar while Kostas waits for the dinner rush.
Saganaki hitting the pan — the flame, the 'Opa!' from a regular.
Yiayia's phyllo stretched paper-thin across the whole kitchen bench at 7am.
The Norwood Friday-night crowd spilling off The Parade as the bouzouki playlist starts.

event_failure_modes.greek_orthodox_easter: The single biggest booking week of the year; after-hours demand floods in and the calls ring out.
event_failure_modes.adelaide_glendi_festival: Greek-community festival drives a dinner surge; bookings lost to venues whose phones get answered.
event_failure_modes.quandoo_shutdown: Quandoo closes (migration deadline 30 Sep 2026); Thea needs a replacement booking system before the spring rush.

kostas.before_bella: Stranded on Quandoo as it shuts down, and missing after-hours calls during the Greek-community dinner trade — Yiayia answering in Greek while the English bookings ring out.
kostas.after_bella: Migrated to a commission-free line that answers in Greek and English. The Saturday glendi books itself; Kostas is back on the floor pouring wine instead of chasing the phone.
kostas.personality: Big, warm, loud laugh — feeds everyone, remembers every regular's order. Proud of the family name. Yiayia is the real boss and he knows it.
kostas.voice: Adelaide-Greek English; switches to Greek with Yiayia and the regulars.
says: Yiayia says the phyllo's not ready. Yiayia is always right.
never_says: Anything that makes Yiayia look behind the times
